隐私政策

这份说明介绍「放下手机」如何处理你的信息。

保存在设备上的信息

挑战记录、累计坚持时间与经验、最近使用的时长、语言和自定义文案保存在本机，用于计时、记录展示、徽章进度及恢复设置。当前应用没有账号系统和应用内云端同步。

可选广告

主动选择观看广告时，应用会连接 Google 广告服务。Google Mobile Ads 可能处理 IP 地址、设备标识、广告互动、性能及崩溃信息，用于广告、诊断与防作弊。开发者没有把挑战记录或自定义文案附加到广告请求。广告加速仅在广告服务可用时提供。

隐私选择

观看广告是自愿的，普通挑战可以直接使用。需要广告隐私选择时，设置中会提供相关入口。当前应用没有请求跨应用跟踪授权，也没有请求相机、麦克风、照片或通讯录权限。

保留与删除

本机信息随使用持续保留。删除应用可删除该应用在设备上的本机数据；如启用 iOS 系统备份，备份副本按系统备份设置管理。重新安装或更换设备前，请考虑本机记录可能无法恢复。

帮助与联系

使用或隐私问题可通过使用帮助和联系我们页面查看支持方式。你可以复制反馈模板，并通过在线联系页面的 GitHub Issues 提交反馈。公开反馈中请勿包含私人记录或敏感信息。

说明更新

数据用途或广告配置发生变化时，会同步更新这份说明。本地 HTML 可离线查看，没有统计脚本或在线表单；仅在你主动打开外部链接时连接对应网站。

网站访问

本地 HTML 可以离线阅读。公开帮助网站使用 GitHub Pages 托管；访问在线页面时，GitHub 会为安全目的记录并保存访问者的 IP 地址。本网站没有另外添加统计脚本、广告或自动提交反馈的表单。主动打开外部链接后，适用对应网站的隐私说明。

使用帮助

选好时长，开始计时后把手机放在一旁，去做一件屏幕之外的事。

开始放下手机

可输入小时与分钟，范围为 1 分钟至 24 小时。点击空白处可收起键盘，确认时长后点击「开始放下手机」，再把手机放在一旁。

保持当前页面

把手机放在一旁，并让应用保持在前台。切换应用、失去焦点、主动锁屏或提前结束，本次挑战会记为未完成；已有累计时间和经验保留。

屏幕与电量

计时期间屏幕保持亮起并自动调暗，结束后恢复原亮度。进度条显示已完成的比例，不播放持续动画。你可以把手机放在一旁，阅读、整理或安静休息。

最近使用的时长

快捷选项保留最近使用的 4 个时长。成功开始挑战后，该时长移到最前；新时长替换最久没用的一项。列表保存在本机，重新打开后仍然保留。

文案与徽章

应用语言跟随 iPhone 设置，可通过「系统语言设置」跳转修改。设置里只显示当前语言的提醒，切换语言后仍保留原有文案。徽章自动解锁，点击首页等级卡可查看。

广告加速

勾选「看广告，经验 ×1.5」后，点击「开始放下手机」会先播放广告。观看完成后点广告自己的 × 关闭，返回后自动计时，本次挑战成功可获得 1.5 倍经验；无需点击广告内容。提前关闭、加载失败或取消时，会按普通经验开始。计时中的静态广告点击后可能跳转并导致失败；图片素材不可用时广告位会隐藏。

联系我们

告诉我们哪里不顺手，或者下一版你希望改进什么。

反馈内容

请描述问题发生前的操作、看到的结果与希望的结果。反馈模板包含应用版本和 iOS 版本，你可以自行编辑后再发送。

保护你的隐私

截图和反馈中只需保留与问题有关的信息。反馈模板不会自动附加挑战记录或自定义文案，也不会自动发送。

可复制下方反馈模板，通过 GitHub Issues 提交问题或建议。

通过 GitHub Issues 反馈

反馈会公开展示，请勿提交私人记录、账号信息或含敏感信息的截图。

Privacy Policy

This notice explains how Phone Down handles your information.

Information stored on your device

Challenge history, total time and XP, recent durations, language and custom messages are stored locally for timing, history, badge progress and restoring preferences. The app currently has no account system or in-app cloud sync.

Optional advertising

Choosing to watch an ad connects to Google advertising services. Google Mobile Ads may process IP addresses, device identifiers, ad interactions, performance and crash information for advertising, diagnostics and fraud prevention. The developer does not attach challenge history or custom messages to ad requests. Ad boosts are offered when advertising is available.

Privacy choices

Ads are optional; you can start normal challenges directly. When ad privacy choices are required, the settings provide an entry point. The app currently does not request cross-app tracking, camera, microphone, photo-library or contacts permission.

Retention and deletion

Local information is retained while you use the app. Deleting the app removes its local data from the device; copies in iOS system backups are managed through system backup settings. Consider that local records may not be recoverable after reinstalling or changing devices.

Help and contact

Visit the Help and Contact pages for support with usage or privacy questions. Copy the feedback template and submit feedback through GitHub Issues on the online Contact page. Please leave private records and sensitive information out of public feedback.

Changes to this notice

This notice will be updated when data use or advertising configuration changes. The local HTML file works offline, without analytics scripts or online forms. External websites are contacted only when you choose to open their links.

Website visits

The local HTML can be read offline. The public help website is hosted on GitHub Pages. When you visit the online pages, GitHub logs and stores visitors’ IP addresses for security purposes. This website has no added analytics scripts, ads or forms that automatically send feedback. External links are governed by the linked website’s privacy notice.

Help

Choose a duration, start the timer, then put your phone aside and enjoy something off-screen.

Start phone-free time

Enter hours and minutes, from 1 minute to 24 hours. Tap a blank area to dismiss the keyboard, choose Start phone-free time, then put your phone aside.

Keep this page open

Put your phone aside and keep the app open in the foreground. Switching apps, losing focus, locking the screen or ending early marks this challenge unfinished. Existing time and XP are preserved.

Screen and battery

The screen stays on and dims while the timer runs, then returns to its previous brightness. The progress bar shows how much time has passed without a continuous animation. Put your phone aside while you read, tidy up or rest quietly.

Recent durations

The shortcuts keep the 4 most recently used durations. Starting a challenge moves its duration to the front; a new duration replaces the least recent one. The list is saved locally and survives relaunches.

Messages and badges

The app follows the language selected in iPhone Settings. Use Language in Settings to change it. Only the current-language reminder is shown for editing; other reminders stay saved when you switch languages. Badges unlock automatically. Open the level card to see them.

Ad boosts

Check Watch an ad · 1.5× XP, then choose Start phone-free time. The ad plays first. Finish watching and close it with its own ×; the timer starts after you return, and completing this challenge earns 1.5× XP. No ad click is needed. Early dismissal, a loading failure or cancellation starts with normal XP. Tapping a static ad during the timer may leave the app and fail the challenge; unsuitable static creatives stay hidden.

Contact

Tell us what feels awkward, or what you would like improved next.

What to include

Describe what you did, what happened and what you expected. The feedback template includes the app and iOS versions; you can edit it before sending.

Protect your privacy

Include only information relevant to the issue in screenshots and feedback. The template does not automatically attach challenge records or custom messages, and is not sent automatically.

Copy the feedback template below and submit issues or suggestions through GitHub Issues.

Send feedback through GitHub Issues

Issues are public. Please leave out private records, account details and screenshots containing sensitive information.
